chunks: And it is narrated from Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, upon them both be peace, that he said:

"Whoever fasts the first day of the ten days of Dhū al-Ḥijjah, Allah will record for him the fasting of eighty months. And if he fasts the nine days, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will record for him the fasting of a lifetime."

key_terms.عَشْرِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: the first ten days of Dhū al-Ḥijjah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting the first nine days of Dhū al-Ḥijjah?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages fasting during the opening days of Dhū al-Ḥijjah by describing the immense reward for doing so. It highlights the special merit of fasting the first day and, even more so, fasting the first nine days.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1806 - It is narrated from Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) who said:

"Whoever fasts the first day of the ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah, Allah (swt) will record for him the reward of fasting eighty months. And if he fasts all nine days, Allah (swt), the Almighty, will record for him the reward of fasting a lifetime."
